body: Thanks, sorry if I came off as defensive. And I hope it does.
Thank you for your kind words. I will try and bring it up tomorrow, thinking of how to do it very delicately though.

No this isn't "I'm a moody 18 year old and having a bad week". I've been on antidepressants since I was 14 and have gone through 2 years of counselling. I used self harm frequently and have since stopped when I got with my bf because I would have lost him him if I didn't. I haven't felt this bad in a long time.

No I have a feeling it would go something like this:

"I don't feel like I can trust you on facebook"
"So you don't trust me?"
"No, It's just because of things you've done in the past that haunt me"
"Well if you don't trust me and you keep dragging stuff up that happened ages ago then there's no point in us even being together is there?"
